sources.quote: SUP-C,Meccanica Chisone S.r.l.,aluminium extrusions and blanks
Correct, the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The proposal moves HS-410 (steel DC04 stamped part, Aurelia per DEV-121) to Meccanica Chisone. The supplier is approved again as a company, but the audit does not give part approvals. No controlled record covers SUP-C for HS-410 at a receiving plant for Aurelia. Its commodity is aluminium extrusions and blanks, not stamping. Absence of a record is not the same as 'not approved', so a person must confirm whether a part, plant and customer release exists.
